name: Small Town Slice of Life
description: Warm, character-driven stories set in Tier-2/Tier-3 Indian cities with quirky locals.

chapters.title: The Local Adda
chapters.description: Establishing the town's rhythm, the local tea stall, and the cast of characters.

chapters.title: The Return
chapters.description: The protagonist returns from the big city, feeling like a failure.

chapters.title: The Meddling Neighbors
chapters.description: Everyone knows everything; dealing with intense lack of privacy.

chapters.title: The Local Rivalry
chapters.description: A petty, long-standing feud between two families or shops.

chapters.title: The Festival
chapters.description: The entire town comes together; a moment of community bonding.

chapters.title: The Big City Threat
chapters.description: A corporation or a new development threatens the town's way of life.

chapters.title: The Unlikely Romance
chapters.description: A slow-burn romance with a childhood friend or local.

chapters.title: The Rebellion
chapters.description: The protagonist takes a stand against the town's conservative views.

chapters.title: The Crisis
chapters.description: A natural disaster or a major personal loss unites the town.

chapters.title: The Resolution
chapters.description: The protagonist finds a way to save the town's spirit or their own family.

chapters.title: The Realization
chapters.description: Realizing that this small town is exactly where they belong.

chapters.title: Life Goes On
chapters.description: The town returns to its rhythm, slightly changed, but enduring.
